notes: Hollow's ghost is the CEO's carriage driver, cut from his ghost-carriage-driver.png with a traced, feathered outline and a key on the dark background (art/hollow-ghost.webp, 0.17 MB). The smoke tail is kept by its green.

The driver appears at either side of the open water, clear of the words. He fades in, drifts and bobs a little, flickers faintly and fades out, his smoke trailing into the water with a faint reflection. A second pass adds his own green…
